meta.name: stitch-loop
meta.description: Teaches agents to iteratively build websites using Stitch with an autonomous baton-passing loop pattern

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 Stitch 迭代构建网站
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要教 agent 用 Stitch 构建网站
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to teach agents to build websites using Stitch

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会成为一个自动前端构建者：它从任务文件读取下一个页面需求，用 Stitch 生成页面，集成到网站，然后写下步任务，形成循环。
howto.when: 当用户要求用 Stitch 构建网站，且项目中已包含 .stitch/next-prompt.md 等必要文件时触发。

say.text: 请根据 baton 文件生成关于页面。
继续网站构建循环，生成下一个页面。
say.note: Claude 会执行一次迭代，然后更新 baton。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes an autonomous frontend builder: it reads the next page requirement from a task file, generates the page using Stitch, integrates it into the site, and writes the next task, forming a loop.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to build a website with Stitch and the project contains necessary files like .stitch/next-prompt.md.

say_en.text: Generate the about page based on the baton file.
say_en.note: Claude will read next-prompt.md, generate and integrate the about page.

say_en.text: Continue the site build loop and generate the next page.
say_en.note: Claude will execute one iteration and update the baton.
